author: olpipi
title: Windows build fails: MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async overriding virtual function return type differs and is not covariant
signature: conflicting return type specified for virtual hint_prefetch_async override|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: MSVC cl.exe fails compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp with C2555: overriding virtual function return type differs and is not covariant

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_windows
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the Build / Build job failed

key_errors: C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\core\tests\ov_tensor_test.cpp(1370): error C2555: 'ov::test::`anonymous-namespace'::MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async': overriding virtual function return type differs and is not covariant from 'ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async'
root_cause: PR #38993 changed the pure-virtual method ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async in src/common/util/include/openvino/util/mmap_object.hpp (line 85) from returning void to returning util::PrefetchToken, as part of the new PrefetchScheduler feature. The MockMappedMemory test double in src/core/tests/shared_buffer.cpp (a file the PR changed) was updated to match, but a separate, pre-existing MockMappedMemory mock in the anonymous namespace of src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (line 1370, not in the PR's changed-files list) was missed and still declares MOCK_METHOD(void, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t, size_t), (override)). This is a deterministic, toolchain-independent compile error (GCC reports 'conflicting return type', MSVC reports C2555) that reproduces on every configuration that compiles ov_core_unit_tests; it has now been seen on Linux RISC-V/GCC, Windows Debug/MSVC, Linux ARM64 cross-compilation/GCC, and now this Windows Release/MSVC build.
reproduction_steps: Configure and build ov_core_unit_tests against the PR branch on any toolchain, e.g.: cmake -G Ninja -DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON -S . -B build && cmake --build build --target ov_core_unit_tests. The error reproduces compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp because its local MockMappedMemory mock still uses the old void-returning signature.
recommended_actions: Update the MOCK_METHOD declaration for hint_prefetch_async in src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (around line 1370) to MOCK_METHOD(ov::util::PrefetchToken, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t offset, size_t size), (override)) to match the new interface signature in mmap_object.hpp:85, mirroring the already-correct mock in src/core/tests/shared_buffer.cpp.
Grep the whole tree for any other MOCK_METHOD/hand-written overrides of MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async that may need the same signature update before re-queueing.
Re-run the full unit test build locally with -Werror before pushing to catch similar interface/mock mismatches early.
prevention_strategies: When changing a pure-virtual method's signature (return type, parameters, or noexcept-ness) in a public interface header, grep the whole tree for MOCK_METHOD/MOCK_CONST_METHOD declarations and hand-written overrides of that method and update all of them in the same commit, not just the ones referenced by the PR's own changed-files list. Add a CI/pre-commit grep check that flags mock declarations whose signature no longer matches the interface they implement.
historical_context: Fourth recurrence of signature_hash 4178da568a100f35 for PR #38993 within roughly 70 minutes: first in run 41095713725 (Linux RISC-V, Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.10), then run 41095713937 (Windows Debug, MSVC), then run 41095713943 (Linux ARM64 cross-compilation, Python 3.11), and now run 41095714229 (Windows VS2022 Release, MSVC). Same root cause (stale MockMappedMemory override in ov_tensor_test.cpp, not yet fixed in the PR) surfacing across every toolchain/platform that builds ov_core_unit_tests. The fix has not landed yet; the PR must update ov_tensor_test.cpp before requeueing.
